question: Which official body is responsible for regulating midwifery practice in Nigeria?

options.A: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria
options.B: National Association of Nigerian Nurses and Midwives

explanation: The Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria (NMCN) is the statutory body established to control and regulate nursing and midwifery education and practice across the country. [learn more](BMP322_U1_T3#BMP322_U1_T3_h1)

question: Why is a newly qualified midwife's name entered into the official council register?

options.A: To grant automatic membership into the national union
options.B: To secure an automatic salary grade level in the federal civil service
options.C: To legally protect the public by allowing only qualified persons to practice
options.D: To qualify the individual for international relocation scholarships

explanation: Official registration establishes a legal boundary to ensure that only individuals who have proven their competence are permitted to care for patients. [learn more](BMP322_U1_T3#BMP322_U1_T3_h1)

question: What exam must a midwifery student pass before receiving an initial license from the council?
explanation: Passing the NMCN professional qualifying examination is a compulsory requirement before any graduate can be licensed to practice. [learn more](BMP322_U1_T3#BMP322_U1_T3_h2)

question: A student just finished her final exams and wants to start working immediately in the maternity unit. What must she secure first?

options.A: A letter of recommendation from the local government
options.B: Her union identity card and clearance form
options.C: Her practicing license and registration certificate
options.D: A personal indemnity insurance policy document

explanation: Practicing without the official license and registration certificate is illegal, even if the candidate has finished all school examinations. [learn more](BMP322_U1_T3#BMP322_U1_T3_h2)

question: How often does a practicing midwife in Nigeria need to renew her practicing license?
explanation: The current licensing policy requires midwives to renew their practicing license every three years alongside proof of accumulated CPD points. [learn more](BMP322_U1_T3#BMP322_U1_T3_h3)

question: What is the main difference between having a registration certificate and having a valid practicing license?

options.A: The license grants active, current legal permission to practice, whereas the certificate proves initial qualification
options.B: The license is issued by the hospital management, while the certificate is issued by the federal ministry
options.C: The certificate expires every year, while the license remains valid for a lifetime
options.D: The certificate allows you to work abroad, while the license is strictly for local primary health centers

explanation: The registration certificate is a one-time award, but the practicing license is an active permit that must be renewed regularly to show current fitness to practice. [learn more](BMP322_U1_T3#BMP322_U1_T3_h3)

question: What is the main goal of Continuing Professional Development (CPD) for midwives?

options.A: To update knowledge and skills with current evidence-based practices
options.B: To replace formal basic midwifery school training entirely
options.C: To fulfill strict hospital promotion interview criteria
options.D: To increase the monthly financial allowances of staff

explanation: CPD programs are designed to keep practitioners abreast of modern developments and standards in maternal and child health. [learn more](BMP322_U1_T3#BMP322_U1_T3_h4)

question: Which of the following does NOT count as earning CPD points for license renewal?

options.A: Routine daily performance of ward shift duties
options.D: Completing recognized online midwifery update courses

explanation: Routine work duties are part of normal employment tasks and do not count as formal Continuing Professional Development activities. [learn more](BMP322_U1_T3#BMP322_U1_T3_h4)

question: What is it called when a qualified midwife continues to attend births with an expired practicing license?
explanation: Practicing without a current, valid license reduces a trained professional to the legal status of an unqualified practitioner or quack. [learn more](BMP322_U1_T3#BMP322_U1_T3_h5)

question: A midwife works with an expired license in her private clinic. What is the most direct risk she faces if a patient suffers serious harm?

options.A: Criminal prosecution for illegal practice alongside possible imprisonment
options.B: A simple warning letter from the local nurses association
options.C: Mandatory transfer to a rural primary healthcare facility
options.D: Temporary deduction from her pension savings account

explanation: Practicing without a valid license strips away professional indemnity and legal protection, exposing the offender to severe criminal charges. [learn more](BMP322_U1_T3#BMP322_U1_T3_h5)
